The decisive mistake was Cubing_Expert's unjustified elimination at step 1. It declared the missing piece "Red-White" without showing that the constraints excluded every other two-colored piece. The constraints don't rule out a green-white edge: the green pieces required to be found are only the corners and the green edges bordering yellow, so a green-white edge could be the missing one. Verification_Expert at step 2 repeated the same unsupported conclusion instead of checking it, but the wrong answer originated at step 1.
